notes: ὁ ἐπικληθείς: one English word is written for the pair, so the article takes the relativizer who and the participle keeps was surnamed (rule 90).
Κύπριος → a man of Cyprus heads on Cyprus, man being the supplied generic completion (rule 66); τῷ γένει gives the article nothing to anchor and by stays with the noun (rules 21, 23).
